sections.title: Origins
sections.text: RISC-V began in 2010 at the University of California, Berkeley, as an open instruction set for research and teaching.

sections.title: Governance
sections.text: The RISC-V Foundation formed in 2015 to steer the standard. In 2020 it became RISC-V International, based in Switzerland.

sections.title: Adoption
sections.text: The base integer instruction set and the privileged architecture were ratified in 2019, and chips from many vendors now use them.
